implementedFeatures: Upload and persistent replacement of products.json and days.json
Parsing of products.json as product-id keyed object
Parsing of days.json as date keyed object
Linking consumed product entries to products by product_id
Support for consumed.simple_products, including AI generated meals
Copy day or meal summaries to clipboard with fallback
Excel export for one day or date range, one sheet per day
PDF export for one day or date range
Direct Yazio sync from username/password and date range
Incremental Yazio sync snapshots with consolidated products.json and days.json
Automatic sync recommendation from the oldest incomplete import day or the last 14 days to today
Local personal settings for name and birth date
Local per-day notes for export field 'Besonderheiten an diesem Tag'
Tabbed UI sections for analysis, Yazio import, profile, and admin
Help page, tooltips, and first-start guidance for empty data stores
Yazio import runs as a background job with pollable status and a scrollable UI log panel
Codebase refactored into packages: export, json, model, service, sync

codeStructure.de.yazio.overview.sync: Yazio API sync client and sync job status
